root_cause.text: The `cpuidle_select()` function fails to bypass the governor when only a single idle state is registered, allowing governors like the ladder governor to select an out-of-bounds state index (state 1) if state 0 is a polling state.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (drv->state_count <= 1)` in `cpuidle_select()` to return state 0 directly, bypassing the governor, which prevents the ladder governor from incorrectly treating state 1 as the first usable state and passing an out-of-bounds index when only a single polling state is available.
